FSL-1.1-ALv2 covers first-party packages; this is not current Apache-2.0 licensing. npm SHA1 6d2df459e798584501213567efd96f816fa406b0 matches downloaded bytes. Linked GitHub repository returns 404; no Git commit is invented.

evidence.title: access
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Node CLI launches server/dispatcher and React/Vite browser UI; commands include up, run, abort, threads, serve, discover, install, onramp and cancel. Client SDK exposes typed HTTP/SSE operations with reconnect handling. No desktop binary, mobile native app or editor extension in this distribution.

evidence.title: providers
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Built-ins are Claude, Codex and OpenCode. Claude supports Windows/POSIX and OAuth/API/ambient login; Codex POSIX auth-file/API/ambient; OpenCode OpenRouter API. Native sessions, events and usage are normalized. Guide receives no MCP config; no general first-party MCP-client configuration surface found in these adapters.

evidence.title: policy
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Tier requirements fail closed if unsupported; unrestricted is explicit. Claude uses default permission mode and canUseTool for restricted policies, bypassPermissions only unrestricted. Codex maps supported tiers to sandbox/approval settings; interactive approval is not a general headless flow. Provider enforcement remains external.

evidence.title: executor
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Host mode directly spawns processes without OS isolation. Container mode builds rootless Podman/Docker invocation, workspace mount, per-Thread runtime home and readonly per-Run credential mount, CPU/RAM/PID limits and a required zozo-cell network. Private-range egress blocking depends on configured network; missing network fails rather than falls back.

evidence.title: git
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Host adapter uses Git worktrees; Cell adapter uses independent blobless clones, avoiding shared .git hooks/config. Dispatcher Git applies hostile-workspace flags and host-scoped credentials, validates heads and can recover remote branches. Code separation is distinct from host process security.

evidence.title: journal
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: SQLite retains stable Threads, Runs and ordered Events; deletion removes records and is not immutable auditing. Replay seeds restore lost sessions from digests/recent workblocks under a context budget; compaction and missing runtime sessions can lose fidelity.

evidence.title: objective
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Accepted title/body is content-addressed with SHA-256; linked attempts retain snapshots and revisions. Completion declarations validate completed/incomplete/blocked fields. This snapshot is not an automatic semantic proof of acceptance criteria.

evidence.title: steers
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: SQLite transaction orders steers; pending/offered/uncertain/acknowledged state survives restart and pending delivery prevents objective completion. Claude safe input waits for tool boundaries; transport acknowledgment is not proof every requested effect occurred.

evidence.title: budget
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Turn/token/cost/wall-clock conditions are evaluated at runtime. Objective allowance spans linked Runs and explicit extensions; adopting a revision does not reset it. Missing configured usage is uncertain and can block continuation; dollar accounting is runtime-reported, not an invoice cap.

evidence.title: admission
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: General slots are shared by targeted/fleet work; interactive reserve is separate. Claims and leases suppress duplicate project/issue work in one dispatcher; priority then age and pacing determine selection. Cell memory allocation uses detected host RAM and reserves, not just UI concurrency.

evidence.title: blockers
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: GitHub native blockers and same-repository ## Blocked by references are unioned; unreadable states remain UNKNOWN and block. Jira uses native links, not GitHub-number body parsing. Frontier reconciler and dispatch use shared blocker logic; cross-project display references do not imply cross-project dispatch dependencies.

evidence.title: intake
evidence.locator: validateDocDeltas; topological ordering; intake publisher; label-catalog
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Plans validate document-delta targets and dependency ordering, stamp base SHA and reject cycles; publication creates tracker issues. Versioned labels distinguish eligibility, classification and inert labels. This is not a standalone local issue database.

evidence.title: snapshot
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: External tracker slices refresh every 30 seconds attended or five minutes idle. Failed refresh retains last good data with timestamp; generation invalidation prevents stale responses replacing newer slices. BFF exposes issue/Run/attention views, not a native team RBAC or issue-assignee database.

evidence.title: landing
evidence.locator: head reconciliation; base refresh; checks; landWithoutPassingChecks; forge.mergePullRequest
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Queue reconciles remote/local heads, refreshes base, waits for checks and performs bounded repair. Explicit Unverified landing can bypass failing/absent/pending checks and records that decision. Fresh ancestry is checked before merge, but the merge call is not an independent human approval bound by expected-head CAS.

evidence.title: checks
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Build/test tool calls and result IDs are matched; pipeline outcomes may remain ran-without-outcome. Repair evidence bounds logs/jobs. Claude completion hooks block finishing while tracked background work remains; these checks do not prove semantic spec compliance.

evidence.title: usage
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Final runtime reports replace live observations; absent cost remains unavailable, not zero. Completeness and coverage are retained; token merging avoids overlap. Thread and daily/credential summaries are derived from journal facts; no provider invoice or compute billing reconciliation.

evidence.title: export
evidence.locator: manifest; raw journal; git bundles; backup.js; updater.js
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Export builds a manifest, raw journal and unshipped Git bundles after fresh fetch; temporary files are cleaned. Encrypted backup includes journal/dispatcher state, not full workspace or credentials. Updater backs up state before atomic version switch.

evidence.title: secrets
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Credential directories/files use restrictive modes and atomic writes; exact secret values of at least eight characters are redacted in event payloads, not every representation. Host replacement uses attempt-bound sealed migration. Stack session tokens are hashed with TTL/revocation; this is not organizational RBAC.

evidence.title: mcp
evidence.locator: MCP HTTP handler; token registry; proposals
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Self-hosted endpoint has hashed named tokens, per-request revocation checks and four docs/settings/proposal tools. Proposal is not application: human dashboard mutation checks snapshot revision. Hosted availability is separately documented as disabled.

evidence.title: webhooks
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Optional outbound event POSTs filter event types, retry three times with bounded backoff and do not block Runs; delivery queue is in memory. Local server routes expose Threads/Runs/events/credentials; not an Internet-safe general webhook intake service.

evidence.title: push
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Browser push is dormant without complete VAPID configuration. Poller covers needs-attention, failure, PR ready, shipped and session-turn categories; handles endpoint expiry and rate limits. Local quickstart does not configure hosted push.

evidence.title: bundles
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Local/npm agent bundles are discoverable/installable; JSON agent manifests and provider registry are extensible in code. Public v0.41.9 does not contain the newer v0.43 project YAML subagent contract. Installing an untrusted npm bundle is not sandboxed extension execution.

evidence.title: local
evidence.finding: Accountless local stack on macOS/Linux/Windows 10 22H2 or 11 with Node 22/24/26, Git and a supported runtime. Native Windows supports Claude only. Local stack is loopback personal host-process mode, requires explicit acknowledgment and stops when terminal closes. Hosted push/backups unavailable.

evidence.title: auth
evidence.finding: Control-plane, Stack, runtime and tracker credentials are separate. Hosted GitHub OAuth signup has daily admission limit; Stack login uses short-lived one-use handoff. Named subscription credentials require recorded consent; provider terms remain external and support may be withdrawn.

evidence.title: routing
evidence.finding: Named primary/fallback credential routes per activity; model and effort profiles. Claude/Codex subscription or API and OpenCode/OpenRouter API. Existing Threads retain credential/profile; new Threads adopt edits.

evidence.title: project
evidence.finding: GitHub+GitHub or Bitbucket Cloud+Jira Cloud project routes. Review-paced, Full speed and Autonomous presets distinguish pacing/open PR/automatic merge. Add project can create a private repository; existing empty repositories need first commit. Build/test commands are configured.

evidence.title: intake-doc
evidence.finding: Small read-only intake, Medium grilling/planning and Large Wayfinder research/tickets turn prompts into explicitly published issues and parent Specs. Merely chatting does not dispatch work.

evidence.title: specs
evidence.finding: Parent Spec issues, children and optional Spec branches collect PRs. Final landing requires all children closed and at least one completed; base refresh and bounded conflict/check repair run through landing. Automatic Spec landing is separately opt-in.

evidence.title: guidance
evidence.finding: Repository CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md and ADRs provide durable guidance; document deltas land as code. New v0.43 project agent files add policy/roles but vendor agent folders are ignored. No automatic semantic conflict solver is promised.

evidence.title: subagents
evidence.finding: v0.43 documentation adds .zozo/agent.md and .zozo/agents/*.md with model/effort/policy/stop/ceiling. Claude/Codex delegation has default ceiling four and depth one under plan cap. Claude exposes inner transcript/tool policy; Codex has less inner visibility/tool filtering and lower-bound usage; OpenCode subagents unsupported. Not source-verified in public v0.41.9.

evidence.title: dispatch
evidence.finding: Auto dispatch defaults to five minutes and wakes on freed slot/landing, refreshes frontier every minute, respects blockers/pacing/priority. Missing or malformed completion declaration can advance committed work with disclosed verification gap; actual failed checks and explicit incomplete outcomes continue or stop for attention. Three no-progress continuations stop.

evidence.title: controls
evidence.finding: Pause preserves workspace/history; abort resets attempt; delete idle/paused work discards records and requires unshipped-work confirmation. Resume/recovery retains accepted objective, revision adoption is explicit, pending steers block completion. Codex steer uses interrupt/continue, OpenCode next turn, Claude safe boundary.

evidence.title: quotas
evidence.finding: Effective concurrency is minimum of setting and plan cap, plus interactive reserve and watched-project cap. Downgrades constrain new admissions without stopping existing Runs. Quotas are not dollar spend limits.

evidence.title: work
evidence.finding: Hosted Cells use rootless containers and independent code workspaces; per-thread runtime home retains history. Runtime/toolchain policy differs from unsandboxed local mode; user owns dependencies and project services.

evidence.title: toolchain
evidence.finding: mise honors declared toolchain/version files before Run, with bounded failures; absent declaration uses supplied Node/Python baseline. package.json engines is not a toolchain declaration; installing application dependencies/services remains project work.

evidence.title: prototype
evidence.finding: Prototyping retains revision Runs, screenshot and preview. One bounded dev-server attempt uses installed dependencies, no automatic network repair. Explicit handoff pushes a throwaway branch into new Intake; prototype flow is GitHub-only.

evidence.title: guide
evidence.finding: Guide uses version-matched docs and bounded allowlisted snapshot with no secrets or live write/network tools; images accepted. Proposed setting changes require human Apply and stale revision is refused. Thread snapshots include summaries, not full transcripts.

evidence.title: mcp-doc
evidence.finding: Self-hosted MCP exposes docs search/read, settings read and propose_change only. Hosted /mcp returns 404; proposals still require human dashboard application.

evidence.title: slack
evidence.finding: v0.42+ Slack notifications/replies and allowlisted participant answers in existing threads. Thirty-second quiet window, first answer wins, concurrent responder refused, replay deduplication documented. Cannot create top-level tasks or publish plans in Slack. Not source-verified in public v0.41.9.

evidence.title: privacy
evidence.finding: Code, prompts, journal and credentials remain on chosen Stack except model/service requests. Control plane stores billing/lifecycle/aggregate usage and defined health fields. Hosted EU Germany/Finland residency, encrypted separate-store backups, bounded exact-value secret redaction, and explicit destructive exit are documented. Provider policy stays separate.

evidence.title: break-glass
evidence.finding: Support can request timed SSH with full sudo; user grants/denies/revokes from banner. Emergency override can open after notification without consent; control plane records windows. This grants access to journal, workspaces and credentials.

evidence.title: billing
evidence.finding: Public monthly USD before tax: Standard $40, 2 shared vCPU/4GB/40GB, general 1/reserve 1/projects 3; Plus $50, 4/8GB/80GB, 3/1/6; Pro $60, 8/16GB/160GB, 5/2/12. Model costs separate, no inference markup. Fourteen-day first-payment money-back policy closes account on refund. Fixed-term operator Grants are card-free, not ongoing free hosted service.

evidence.title: exit
evidence.finding: Closing account cancels billing and destroys Stacks after explicit unshipped-work acknowledgment. Export first; suspension/decommission lifecycle has distinct retention windows.

evidence.title: export-doc
evidence.finding: Export is raw Event journal, manifest and Git bundles of unshipped work, not secrets or whole workspace backup; backups restore into a fresh Stack, not overwrite live one.

evidence.title: release
evidence.finding: Latest documentation release v0.43.2 on 2026-11-13; public npm latest v0.41.9 on 2026-10-28. v0.42 adds Slack/feedback and restart fixes; v0.43 adds project subagents and Grants. Do not attribute these newer changes to older public code.

evidence.title: keyboard
evidence.locator: onKeyDown; selectedRunId keyboard handler; sheet dialog
evidence.finding: Public npm v0.41.9 distribution: Bundled UI binds Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to submit, slash to focus steer and j/k to select Runs outside input fields; Escape dismisses eligible sheets/popovers. No observed usability claim.

evidence.title: Hosted service terms
evidence.finding: Terms dated 2026-11-02 name Ryan Graham as seller; hosted service is for adult business/professional use, restricts competitive use, and is distinct from FSL distributed package. No content/output training, fine-tuning or evaluation; provider policy separate. Monthly advance billing, end-period cancellation, first-payment refund and notice rules published.

evidence.title: Privacy policy
evidence.finding: Policy dated 2026-07-19 names Ontario controller, account/service/billing data, Stripe payment processing, legal retention and necessary cookies only; not a complete current subprocessor inventory.

evidence.title: Zozo hosted diagnostic reporting gates
evidence.locator: control-plane-client.js loadControlPlaneConfigFromEnv/reportStatus/reportUsage; dispatch-supervisor.js start/reportHeartbeatNow/reportUsageNow; serve.js supervisor construction; CLI up.js; all first-party package manifests and web bundle
evidence.finding: Hosted bootstrap URL and token enable periodic status/health and aggregate usage POSTs. Without that bootstrap the local supervisor stays inert. Inspected first-party packages for analytics, telemetry, PostHog, Segment, Sentry and crash reporting; provider usage events and console logs are local/task accounting, not separate vendor analytics. The closed control-plane UI may have controls outside this distribution, so a universal hosted off-switch absence is not established.

before.telemetry_defaults: Hosted health and aggregate usage reporting is defined separately from content; local update checks can be disabled, and newer optional feedback is manual. The cited docs do not establish a control that disables all hosted diagnostic reporting; billing and model-provider requests have separate purposes and policies.

after.telemetry_defaults: Hosted Stack: on by default. With hosted control-plane bootstrap, the public npm 0.41.9 dispatcher starts timers that post status/health, admission, active and pending run counts and aggregate usage to the Zozo control plane. Accountless local Stack without that bootstrap: the inspected public packages contain no ADE analytics or crash client, and the status reporter stays inert; npm update checks and newer manual feedback are separate. Model-provider requests and local journal logs are not ADE telemetry.
after.telemetry_off_switch: The inspected hosted Stack sends operational health and aggregate usage reports when control-plane bootstrap is configured. The current docs and public local package do not establish a user control that disables all hosted ADE diagnostics. Hosted account/control-plane implementation is closed. Disabling npm update checks or optional feedback is not such a control.
